decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the  extensions are occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extensions  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 113 Roxborough Avenue.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of first floor side and single storey rear extension and conversion of existing garage to habitable room.
